Web search with a query that returns no results

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"xyznonexistent12345xyz\"}", SearchRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.search(request)
    println(result)
}
```
